topics.name: Contract Format Bootstrap
topics.purpose: Define the bootstrap relationship to the root-level `AIGMos_Canonical_Contract_Format_v1.4.0.json` that must be loaded before reading ordinary canonical contracts.

semantics.location_rule: The active Contract Format bootstrap artifact is located at the project/package root.
semantics.ordering_rule: Bootstrap Contract Format first; only then parse/validate canonical/json/**.
semantics.type_rule: The bootstrap artifact defines the contract format and is not an ordinary canonical contract contained by the tree it defines.
semantics.authority_rule: The bootstrapped Contract Format is authoritative for structural interpretation of Contract Format 1.4 artifacts.
semantics.path_rule: `canonical/json/00_Contract_Format.json` is not an active 1.4 bootstrap path.

invariants.rule: Contract Format bootstrap authority is resolved before the canonical contract tree and is never treated as an ordinary canonical contract inside canonical/json/**.

hard_gates.condition: canonical contracts parsed authoritatively before Contract Format bootstrap
root Contract Format treated as ordinary contained canonical contract
